_meta.standard: Real Y-Tower cable sizing & voltage-drop convention (EL-CAL-5002 cable sheet, p.15)
_meta.note: Per-feeder cable selection: smallest standard CSA whose derated ampacity >= feeder current AND whose voltage drop <= 4.0%. Cu/PVC, 3-phase 400 V, resistivity 22.5. Indicative — an engineer confirms per project.

csa_ladder_mm2._source: Standard Cu sizes used on the real LV-01 feeders

mv_per_a_per_m._source: EL-CAL-5002 cable sheet mv/a/meter column (fixed per CSA; already includes the 3-phase √3 factor)

derated_ampacity_a._source: Back-solved from EL-CAL-5002 feeder selections (≈ IEC free-air PVC/Cu ampacity × ~0.5 grouping/temperature derating). NOT printed in the document — inferred; an engineer should replace with the project cable schedule's rating.
derated_ampacity_a._note: key = cable CSA (mm2); the smallest CSA whose value >= feeder current is the ampacity-adequate size

vd_ceiling_pct._source: EL-CAL-5002 — feeders held at or below 4.0% (F34 sits exactly at 4.0%)
